claim: The exam guide says the exam also validates a candidate's ability to design solutions that incorporate AWS services to meet current business requirements and future projected needs, and to design architectures that are secure, resilient, high-performing, and cost-optimized.
question: Which design abilities does the exam guide say the exam also validates?

values.display: meet current business requirements and future projected needs

evidence.quote: The exam also validates a candidate's ability to complete the following tasks:
Design solutions that incorporate AWS services to meet current business requirements and future projected needs
Design architectures that are secure, resilient, high-performing, and cost-optimized

note: The exam guide lists three tasks. The third, 'Review existing solutions and determine improvements', is a 6-word list line without a period that M4 cannot accept as a quote, so this fact covers the two quotable tasks only; the book must not state the third as a fact. Repaired 2026-10-11 after a partial entail vote.
